summary: Verified auth fix + MaiHarta developer credit footers end-to-end. Backend login (API) succeeds with admin/bpdjaya3x after BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD re-hash logic. UI login via /login page works with mocked captcha id (planted in DB); wrong password shows exact expected error and correct password reaches dashboard. Developer credit is present with correct text, https://www.maiharta.com href, and target=_blank on login panel footer, login page footer, and app footer. Sidebar navigation (Dashboard/Ketentuan/Kuis) works with no errors. No compile overlay present (three/@react-three/fiber install is healthy).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py initialize_auth now correctly re-hashes when stored bcrypt does not match BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD and clears lockout — root cause of the login regression is addressed.
DeveloperCredit component in branding.js is reused across all three footers (login-panel, login-page, app) with data-testid + target=_blank + rel=noopener noreferrer — matches spec.
Minor: Login.jsx lazy-loads @react-three/fiber; ensure package.json pins it so future environments do not break with 'Compiled with problems'.
test_credentials: admin / bpdjaya3x (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). CAPTCHA planted via db.captchas insert with sha256('<id>:ABC123').
seed_data_creation: Inserted two DB captcha docs (test-e2e-ok, test-e2e-bad) with known answer ABC123; single-use, auto-expires. Playwright route interceptor rewrote /api/auth/captcha response id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For UI login tests, plant captcha in db.captchas with hash of '<id>:<answer>', then intercept /api/auth/captcha with page.route to substitute the id field. Do NOT retry wrong password more than 1x per account (5-min lockout after 3 fails, 423).
